summary: Development Factor Methods now open from their own saved files and refresh stored results when upstream datasets change.
details: Current DFM methods load their method JSON and output sidecar without reopening the Input Triangle or Ratio Basis datasets.
Input, Ratio Basis, calculated ratio, average, and ultimate snapshots are stored with independent owned and derived revisions.
ArcRho-managed precedent saves refresh affected DFM results while preserving selections, formulas, Excel-linked stored values, and notes.
Excel freshness checking now runs after the method is ready, never changes stored values automatically, and reports stale or unverifiable links for optional manual refresh.
Legacy DFM methods upgrade once; failed refresh branches retain their last valid publication and are marked for review.
